title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Period Credit Bonus
content:
The registry period credit bonus of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry is added, in percentage points, to the registry credit bonus percent of an order line to which the registrant applies registry credit (her or his own purchase record still in ordered status). It follows the calendar days from the registry's event date to the line's purchase date:

- a line bought on or after the event date and at most the early credit days of **30** after it adds the early credit bonus of **2** percentage points;
- a line bought more than 30 days after the event date and within the registry type's completion window adds the completion credit bonus of **1** percentage point;
- otherwise, for a line bought before the event date or more than the registry type's completion window after it, no registry period credit bonus is added.

## Completion window by registry type (calendar days after the event date)

| Registry type | Completion window | Line bought 0–30 days after | Line bought from day 31 through the window's last day |
|---|---|---|---|
| Celebration Registry | 60 | 2 | 1 |
| Graduation Registry | 60 | 2 | 1 |
| Housewarming Registry | 90 | 2 | 1 |
| Baby Registry | 120 | 2 | 1 |
| Anniversary Registry | 90 | 2 | 1 |
| Wedding Registry | 180 | 2 | 1 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical Housewarming Registry, event date 1 March)

| Purchase date | Days after the event date | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| 28 February | before the event date | none |
| 1 March | 0 | 2 |
| 31 March | 30 | 2 |
| 1 April | 31 | 1 |
| 30 May | 90 | 1 |
| 31 May | 91 | none |
